tasks.label: local-validate-all-variants
tasks.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/efvincent/code/cpp/project-template
rm -rf /tmp/smoke-plain /tmp/smoke-ncurses /tmp/smoke-sdl3 /tmp/smoke-imgui-vk /tmp/smoke-imgui-gl
cargo generate --path ./template --name smoke-plain --define project_description='smoke' --define ui_type='plain' --silent --destination /tmp
cargo generate --path ./template --name smoke-ncurses --define project_description='smoke' --define ui_type='ncurses' --silent --destination /tmp
cargo generate --path ./template --name smoke-sdl3 --define project_description='smoke' --define ui_type='sdl3' --silent --destination /tmp
cargo generate --path ./template --name smoke-imgui-vk --define project_description='smoke' --define ui_type='imgui' --define imgui_backend='glfw_vulkan' --silent --destination /tmp
cargo generate --path ./template --name smoke-imgui-gl --define project_description='smoke' --define ui_type='imgui' --define imgui_backend='glfw_opengl3' --silent --destination /tmp
for p in /tmp/smoke-plain /tmp/smoke-ncurses /tmp/smoke-sdl3 /tmp/smoke-imgui-vk /tmp/smoke-imgui-gl; do
  (cd "$p" && make -j2 && make bear && test -f compile_commands.json)
done
echo "ALL_LOCAL_VALIDATION_PASSED"

## Summary
This phase has been re-scoped to prioritize local validation and defer hosted CI integration for SDL/UI variants.

## What Changed
- Removed GitHub Actions smoke workflow:
  - `.github/workflows/template-smoke.yml` deleted
- Updated contributor policy in `CONTRIBUTING.md`:
  - local full-matrix validation is required before push
  - hosted SDL/UI CI is deferred as a future enhancement
- Updated `README.md`:
  - removed CI matrix coverage claims
  - added future-enhancement note about reintroducing hosted CI once dependency installation is reliable

## Local Validation Performed
Executed clean generation + build validation for all 5 variants from this branch state:
1. `plain`
2. `ncurses`
3. `sdl3`
4. `imgui` + `glfw_vulkan`
5. `imgui` + `glfw_opengl3`

For each generated project:
- `make -j2` passed
- `make bear` passed
- `compile_commands.json` exists

Final validation marker observed:
- `ALL_LOCAL_VALIDATION_PASSED`

## Why This Direction
- Keeps developer feedback loop reliable on known local environments.
- Avoids blocking on unstable hosted package setup for SDL/UI deps.
- Preserves a clear path to add hosted CI later once dependency setup is robust.

## Future Enhancement
- Reintroduce hosted CI smoke checks for all variants after SDL/UI dependency installation is stable on runners.
EOF

cd /home/efvincent/code/cpp/project-template

Add one-command local template validation workflow

## Summary
This PR adds a single-command local validation helper for template contributors and updates contributor-facing docs to use that command as the default pre-push gate.

## Why
After Phase 3, project policy is local-first validation before pushing and hosted SDL/UI smoke CI is deferred. Running the full matrix manually is reliable but repetitive, so this PR improves ergonomics while preserving the same validation standard.

## What changed
- Added `ci/local_validate_matrix.sh` at the repository root.
- Updated `CONTRIBUTING.md` to make the script the primary checklist command.
- Updated `README.md` repository layout to document the new helper script.

## Validation behavior of the new script
- Generates all five template variants under a temporary root.
- Runs `make -j2` for each generated variant.
- Runs `make bear` and verifies `compile_commands.json` exists for each variant.
- Emits `ALL_LOCAL_VALIDATION_PASSED` only after all variants pass.
- Cleans up temporary artifacts via trap by default.
- Supports `KEEP_SMOKE=1` to retain generated projects for debugging.

## Local verification performed
Executed on this branch before pushing:

`sh ci/local_validate_matrix.sh`

Observed terminal success marker:

`ALL_LOCAL_VALIDATION_PASSED`

## Scope and non-goals
- No generated template runtime behavior changed.
- No hosted CI workflow added or modified.
- Hosted SDL/UI CI remains a future enhancement per current project policy.
EOF
gh pr create -B main -H phase-4-local-validation-automation -t "$(cat "$TITLE_FILE")" -F "$BODY_FILE"
